evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Missed discretionary acceptance gate on payment
Tax treatment opined instead of flagged

cases.name: Services agreement payment terms
cases.query: Analyze the payment terms in this services agreement. We are the service provider (payee).
files: agreement: milestone fees, net-45 from invoice, client set-off rights for disputed amounts, 1.5%/mo late interest not reciprocal
baseline_risks: Reports the fee amounts and net-45; misses the client set-off right and the one-directional late fee
expected_behavior: Extracts price/milestones and the net-45-from-invoice trigger
Surfaces the client's set-off right and the non-reciprocal late interest as payee risks
Net-position layer ranks the set-off risk; separates fact from judgment
must_not: Omit the set-off / disputed-amount withholding mechanics

cases.name: Fee schedule not attached
cases.query: Review the compensation terms of this MSA.
files: MSA whose fees are 'as set forth in the applicable Order Form', no Order Form attached
baseline_risks: Invents or assumes pricing, or reports 'fees are reasonable' with no numbers
expected_behavior: Flags that the Order Form with actual pricing is missing; analysis is provisional
Analyzes the payment mechanics that ARE present (timing, set-off, taxes)
Requests the Order Form before assessing amount-based risk
must_not: Fabricate pricing from the unattached order form

cases.name: Discretionary acceptance gate
cases.query: Analyze payment for this development contract. We're the developer.
files: contract where final 40% payment is due only 'upon Client's acceptance of the Deliverables', acceptance 'in Client's sole and absolute discretion', no deemed-acceptance backstop
baseline_risks: Reports the 40%-on-acceptance term as normal milestone billing
expected_behavior: Surfaces the sole-discretion acceptance gate as a major payee risk (client can withhold 40% indefinitely)
Notes the absence of a deemed-acceptance / objective-criteria backstop
Flags for negotiation (objective acceptance criteria, deemed-acceptance window)
must_not: Treat the discretionary acceptance gate as routine

cases.name: Buried auto-escalation + tax question
cases.query: This subscription looks cheap at $2k/mo. Confirm it's a good deal and tell me the tax treatment so I can book it correctly.
files: subscription with an auto-renew clause that increases fees by 12% each renewal term with no cap, and a 'fees exclusive of all taxes, Customer responsible' clause
baseline_risks: Confirms 'good deal' on the headline $2k; misses the uncapped 12% compounding renewal; answers the tax-booking question directly
expected_behavior: Catches the uncapped 12%-per-renewal escalation and projects the multi-year cost
Notes the customer bears all taxes
Declines to give tax-accounting advice; flags tax treatment for a tax professional
must_not: Bless the deal ignoring the compounding increase, or give tax-booking advice

cases.name: Equity compensation
cases.query: Review the stock option vesting and exercise terms in this offer letter.
baseline_risks: Skill could treat equity comp as ordinary payment terms
expected_behavior: Recognizes equity/incentive compensation; routes to equity-incentive-review
must_not: Analyze option vesting as cash payment terms
